name: Residual-voltage monitoring relay
summary: A residual-voltage relay responds to the specified residual-voltage measurement.
description: A residual-voltage relay responds to the specified residual-voltage measurement. Its drawing needs the voltage-transformer connection and the input quantity definition.
readingNotes: Check the measurement circuit that produces the residual voltage.
